safety_verdicts.content: Patient presents with lip swelling for the past 1 hour.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated facts mention lip swelling after prawn soup but do not include the Gold-specified duration of “past 1 hour.”
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting the specific duration (“past 1 hour”) slightly reduces clarity about the acuity and evolution of the lip swelling, which can help frame urgency and response to treatment. However, the note still captures an acute reaction after prawn soup with progression and respiratory symptoms, so immediate management would likely be unchanged.

safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated facts do not mention dizziness.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Dizziness can be a marker of systemic involvement in anaphylaxis (e.g., hypotension/poor perfusion) and may affect assessment of severity and escalation decisions. Omitting it could understate the seriousness of the reaction and reduce the quality of handoff documentation to emergency services.

safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Neither Gold nor transcript explicitly states “no exam or vitals documented”; this is a documentation claim not supported by provided text.
